Name: Eternal Night
Author: CamelliaGasStation
Description:
Lets you choose a type of night forever. Time still changes logically, but visually you can make it always dusk or midnight outdoors.

Pair it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48599][b]Eternal Seasons[/b][/url] for a frozen wilderness where monsters rule the night.
[line]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Choose your preferred night level and color.[/*]
[*]Pick from three different fog styles.[/*]
[*]Allow monsters to appear on vanilla outdoor locations.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Setup[/b]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.3.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Compatible on PC, Cinderbox and SMAPI for Android.[/*]
[*]Use GMCM to configure.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*][b]PC[/b]: Download the file and extract it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]Cinderbox[/b]: Download the file and install in the Mods tab.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI for Android[/b]: Download the file and install it with your launcher's Mod Manager. Please do not extract it manually.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed bug where render target would show as a blank quad in vanilla screenshots
- Replaced vanilla fog texture with custom fog texture
- Added a fog with depth sorting (now default)
- Night colors shows player's intent vs vanilla's subtraction behavior
